Create Stiff plot

Source: R/plots.R
stiff_plot.Rd

Create Stiff plot

Usage

stiff_plot(
  samples,
  ems_id = NULL,
  colour = TRUE,
  legend = TRUE,
  valid = TRUE,
  with_Alk = TRUE
)

Arguments

samples

Data frame. Output from fmt_minimal() or fetch_renmods(). If fetch_renmods() samples will be first formatted with fmt_minimal().

ems_id

IDs to plot if dataset includes more than one

colour

Whether to add colour by ems_id

legend

Whether to show the legend

valid

Logical. Keep only valid data (charge balances <=10)

with_Alk

Logical. Whether to use Meas_Alk_meq for HCO3_meq if missing. Default TRUE. Matches behaviour of water_type().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = c("1401030"),
  date_range = c("1990-01-01", "2026-06-01")
)
stiff_plot(s)
s <- fetch_renmods(
  ems_ids = c("E218582"),
  date_range = c("2026-01-01", "2026-06-01")
)
stiff_plot(s)
}
